mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at 65 degrees near the Verona Area High School. For those looking at the night sky, the International Space Station will be visible tonight starting at 7:40 PM, rising near the northwest horizon and tracking toward the northeast.

City officials have announced that chip seal road maintenance begins on September 23, affecting areas like Cross Country Road and the Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the Plan Commission is set to meet on October 5 to discuss various development projects, while the city remains focused on the goals outlined in the Envision Verona comprehensive plan.

It is a busy couple of days for local fun. Today features the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival, the Dane County Farmers Market, and live music at various local venues. Tomorrow, join the community for the Bike the Barns fundraiser at Badger Prairie County Park, and look forward to yoga on September 21 and trivia nights starting on September 22.
In our weekly police report, on September 3, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for an O W I, second offence, after a vehicle crash on Shooting Star Road.
Culver's of Verona is currently open until 10:30 PM, however, they are closed today for a scheduled facility remodel.
